name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 7 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2025-09-05, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 1.09 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
